What's your return and refund policy?
NANUK.com offers a 30-day return policy for orders placed directly on their website. You may request a replacement or refund if you are not completely satisfied, provided the item is in perfect condition. Returns must be authorized by NANUK first, and a Return Authorization is required before sending the product back. In most cases, return shipping is at the buyer’s expense, except when the issue was due to NANUK's error, in which case they cover the shipping cost. Once the return arrives, it is inspected at the warehouse before a refund is issued to the original method of payment.
This policy applies only to orders placed on NANUK.com and does not apply to wholesale orders or purchases made through third-party websites.
To start a return, you can use the returns portal on the Returns / 30-Day Return Policy page.
